_meta: Scoring anchors per indicator. Each {low, high} pair maps the indicator value to a 0-100 risk score via piecewise-linear interpolation. For 'inverted' indicators (where lower values = higher risk), low > high. These anchors are seeded from the historical distributions at NBER recession onsets (80th pct in -12 to 0 month window pre-peak) vs expansion median; scripts/compute_weights.py overwrites them with values computed from current FRED data.
